reader_summary.overview: Sachin Khajuria is a former partner at Apollo and twenty-five-year veteran of private equity who recently authored "Two and Twenty," a fantastic insider's account of the private equity industry.. Our conversation covers Sachin's rationale for writing Two and Twenty, the strengths of private equity, areas for improvement, and needs for change.

key_points.text: Sachin Khajuria is a former partner at Apollo and twenty-five-year veteran of private equity who recently authored "Two and Twenty," a fantastic insider's account of the private equity industry..
We discuss the defining traits of the industry across the sourcing process, depth of research, use of operating executives, ability to pivot.
We close by discussing opportunities and risks going forward, and Sachin's application of his insights to investing at his family office.
